title.narrative: Development and Implementation of the National Transit System (NTS) of the Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova, compatible with NCTS Phase 5 (NCTS-NTS)

description.narrative: The project specific objective is to develop a National Transit System (NCTS-NTS) based on Web technologies aligned with the NCTS-P5 specifications and national requirements, including country specific deviations. The NCTS-NTS will be developed using ¿open source" technologies, so that its functionality is not conditioned by any licenses. The NCTS-P5 module should be developed so that it could be used separately from ASYCUDAWorld, therefore it should not be developed on the ASYCUDAWorld development framework (middleware).
